title: Democrats now hold slim majority on Texas State Board of Education
summary: Audrey Young, the Republican incumbent running for the District 8 seat on the state board of education, conceded the race Saturday and appeared to close the door for a recount...
content: Audrey Young, the Republican incumbent running for the District 8 seat on the state board of education, conceded the race Saturday and appeared to close the door for a recount request. Democrats will now have a one-seat majority over Republicans for the first time in decades. Source

title: Texas Standard for Nov. 24, 2026: A conversation with Texas’ new comptroller, Sarah Eckhardt
summary: Sarah Eckhardt has served as a Democratic state senator from Austin since 2020. Now, she is set to become the state’s comptroller of public accounts — the first Democrat to...
content: Sarah Eckhardt has served as a Democratic state senator from Austin since 2020. Now, she is set to become the state's comptroller of public accounts — the first Democrat to hold that office since 1999. The comptroller is the official who tells the Legislature how much revenue the state has available to spend. The job also involves oversight of a number of state accounts… Source
